lines.text: Good afternoon. So this is the neck that's been grumbling for a few months?
That's the one. Since last time the morning stiffness lasts about an hour before I can turn my head.
Might be less than that, I don't time it.
And how is it by the evening?
Evening pain is worse after a day at the laptop, since last time I've had tingling into my left thumb twice.
Let me have a look. Turn your head to each side for me.
Turning left you only get about half of what you get to the right, and pressing on the left side of your lower neck reproduces the thumb symptoms.
I wonder whether a joint low down in the neck is irritating the nerve, though it could just as easily be the muscles around it.
Set a timer to get up from the laptop every forty minutes, and raise the screen so the top is level with your eyes.
